name: Amber Palace (Amer Fort)
description: Magnificent hilltop fortress with ornate courtyards, Sheesh Mahal mirror palace, and Maota Lake panoramic views.
address: Devisinghpura, Amer, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302001
tips: Best photography vantage point overlooking Maota lake
Audio guides available in multiple languages

name: Hawa Mahal
description: Iconic pink sandstone Palace of Winds featuring 953 intricately carved jharokhas (windows).
address: Hawa Mahal Rd, Badi Choupad, J.D.A. Market, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302002
tips: Best morning light for front facade photography from across the street
Climb to top for panoramic view of City Palace and Jantar Mantar

name: City Palace Jaipur
description: Royal residence blending Rajput and Mughal architecture with museums displaying royal robes, weapons, and miniature paintings.
address: Tulsi Marg, Gangori Bazaar, J.D.A. Market, Pink City, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302002
tips: Pritam Niwas Chowk features four stunning seasonal gates for photos
Combined museum ticket includes art and armor galleries

name: Jantar Mantar
description: UNESCO World Heritage astronomical observatory housing the world's largest stone sundial built by Sawai Jai Singh II.
address: Gangori Bazaar, J.D.A. Market, Pink City, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302002
tips: Visit between 11 AM and 1 PM for clearest shadow readings on sundials
Official certified guides explain celestial mechanics

name: Laxmi Misthan Bhandar (LMB)
description: Historic dining and sweet institution founded in 1727, famed for authentic Rajasthani Royal Thali and Ghewar.
address: Johari Bazaar, Pink City, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302003
tips: Try the traditional Dal Baati Churma and Paneer Ghewar
AC dining hall upstairs during summer

name: Johari Bazaar & Bapu Bazaar
description: Vibrant traditional shopping quarter renowned for gemstones, silver jewelry, bandhani sarees, and mojari footwear.
address: Johari Bazaar, Pink City, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302003
tips: Bargaining is expected for textiles and handicrafts
Best visited in the evening when street lamps light the pink facades

name: India Gate
description: Imposing 42-meter stone arch war memorial surrounded by fountains, manicured lawns, and the National War Memorial.
address: Kartavya Path, India Gate, New Delhi, Delhi 110001
tips: Evening illumination creates iconic night photography opportunities
Pedestrian-friendly lawns perfect for a relaxed stroll

name: Red Fort (Lal Qila)
description: UNESCO World Heritage red sandstone palace fort that served as the main residence of the Mughal emperors for two centuries.
address: Netaji Subhash Marg, Lal Qila, Chandni Chowk, New Delhi, Delhi 110006
tips: Evening sound and light show narrates Delhi's historic timeline
Closed on Mondays

name: Qutub Minar Complex
description: UNESCO World Heritage complex featuring the 73-meter fluted minaret and the rust-resistant 4th-century Iron Pillar.
address: Seth Sarai, Mehrauli, New Delhi, Delhi 110030
tips: Sunset lighting highlights the intricate calligraphy on red sandstone
Metro station nearby on the Yellow Line

name: Karim's Historic Mughlai
description: Legendary culinary destination founded in 1913 by royal chef Haji Karimuddin, serving royal Mughlai kebabs and curries.
address: Gali Kababian, Jama Masjid, Old Delhi, Delhi 110006
tips: Famous for Mutton Korma, Seekh Kebab, and Khamiri Roti
Combine with visit to Jama Masjid across the lane

name: Taj Mahal
description: World Wonder and UNESCO World Heritage ivory-white marble mausoleum on the south bank of Yamuna river, commissioned by Shah Jahan.
address: Dharmapuri, Forest Colony, Tajganj, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 282001
tips: Sunrise entry offers soft pastel lighting and smallest crowd sizes
Closed on Fridays for general visitors

name: Agra Fort
description: Massive 16th-century Mughal red sandstone fortress with imperial palaces overlooking the Taj Mahal.
address: Agra Fort, Rakabganj, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 282003
tips: Musamman Burj pavilion gives a direct framed view of the Taj Mahal
Walk inside Diwan-i-Khas and Sheesh Mahal

name: Pinch of Spice Restaurant
description: Top-rated North Indian culinary restaurant known for aromatic gravies, kebabs, and family-friendly dining.
address: 1076/2, Fatehabad Rd, Tajganj, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 282001
tips: Advance table reservation recommended during tourist season
Excellent vegetarian and non-vegetarian selections

name: Gateway of India
description: Iconic 26-meter basalt arch monument erected overlooking the Arabian Sea, adjacent to the historic Taj Mahal Palace Hotel.
address: Apollo Bandar, Colaba, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400001
tips: Ferries to Elephanta Caves depart directly from the rear jetty
Early morning cool breeze and sunrise photography

name: Marine Drive (Queen's Necklace)
description: Picturesque 3.6-kilometer curved seaside promenade popular for evening walks and sweeping Arabian Sea vistas.
address: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Road, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400020
tips: Best visited at dusk to see streetlights illuminate Queen's Necklace
Sit on the tetrapods for sunset breeze

name: Baga Beach
description: Vibrant beach in North Goa celebrated for water sports, beach shacks, golden sands, and evening nightlife.
address: Baga Beach, Calangute, Goa 403516
tips: Water sports (parasailing, jet-ski) best enjoyed in morning
Beachside dining at Britto's shack

name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
description: Revered Jyotirlinga temple dedicated to Lord Shiva on the western bank of the holy river Ganga.
address: Lahori Tola, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh 221001
tips: Visit early morning for Mangala Aarti
Corridor connects directly to Ganga ghats

name: Dashashwamedh Ghat
description: Main and most spectacular ghat on the Ganges river, famous for the daily grand evening Ganga Aarti ceremony.
address: Dashashwamedh Ghat Rd, Bangali Tola, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh 221001
tips: Hire a rowboat at 6 PM for the best view of the Aarti ceremony
Mesmerizing brass lamps and chants at sunset

name: Golden Temple (Harmandir Sahib)
description: Most sacred Sikh shrine in the world with golden sanctum surrounded by the holy Amrit Sarovar pool and giant community Langar.
address: Golden Temple Rd, Atta Mandi, Amritsar, Punjab 143006
tips: Head covering and barefoot entry required for all visitors
Langar serves free wholesome meals 24/7 to all people

name: Udaipur City Palace & Lake Pichola
description: Rajasthan's largest royal palace complex situated on the banks of Lake Pichola with balconies, cupolas, and mirror art.
address: Old City, Udaipur, Rajasthan 313001
tips: Sunset boat cruise on Lake Pichola provides stunning views of the palace
Crystal gallery houses unique antique crystal treasures
